LESSON: READING 11.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING: NON-FICTION MATERIALS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.2: Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should we read non-fiction materials?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify print or electronic non- fiction materials that are interesting to read
2. read a variety of grade- appropriate non-fiction materials independently for lifelong learning

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 11.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING: NON-FICTION MATERIALS
This lesson teaches Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials for Grade 7 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify print or electronic non- fiction materials that are interesting to read
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. read a variety of grade- appropriate non-fiction materials independently for lifelong learning
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials above.
2. Explain Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should we read non-fiction materials?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify print or electronic non- fiction materials that are interesting to read
2. read a variety of grade- appropriate non-fiction materials independently for lifelong learning

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
